title: Personal Development Framework
description: A holistic framework for personal growth rooted in Islamic values, covering character development, family and relationship skills, and professional excellence guided by Islamic ethics.

milestones.title: Character Building
milestones.description: Develop core Islamic virtues including patience, gratitude, honesty, and proper etiquette for a well-rounded Muslim character.

milestones.title: Family & Relationships
milestones.description: Build strong family bonds through Islamic guidance on marriage, parenting, and fulfilling the rights and responsibilities of family members.

milestones.title: Professional Growth
milestones.description: Excel in the workplace through effective communication, time management aligned with Islamic principles, and ethical professional conduct.
